jobs.title: Senior Engineering Team Director - Aladdin Engineering ETF Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
About This Role

About Aladdin Engineering

Aladdin is BlackRock’s end-to-end investment management and operations platform — trusted by hundreds of institutional clients and advisors globally, supporting over $21 trillion in assets across the investment lifecycle.

The Aladdin Engineering Group designs and scales technology for tomorrow’s challenges. We build innovative solutions that serve both BlackRock and our global client ecosystem — operating at the speed of a startup with the reach and resources of the world’s largest asset manager. Our engineers take emotional ownership of what they build, shipping products that clients rely on every day.

About ETF Systems

The ETF Systems Engineering team builds the technology powering BlackRock’s iShares primary markets business — the world’s largest ETF franchise. The team owns the ETF Servicing Platform (ESP), a multi-tenant platform at the heart of the ETF ecosystem, enabling ETF Issuers, Authorized Participants, and Service Providers to meet and grow demand for the ETFs they manage, custody, or make markets in.

The engineering organization also owns a suite of mission-critical applications including Basket Management, Order Capture, Order Fulfillment and Custom Basket Negotiation serving clients from ETF Capital Markets, Portfolio Management and Operations across the globe.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Head of Engineering to lead the ETF Systems engineering organization — a globally distributed team of 50+ engineers across San Francisco, New York, Atlanta, London, and Singapore.

This is a senior leadership role accountable for the technical vision, delivery execution, operational excellence, talent strategy, and AI transformation of a platform that underpins one of the fastest-growing segments of the global asset management industry. You will partner closely with Product Management, iShares business leadership, and Aladdin platform teams to scale systems that support new market expansion, new asset classes, and platform commercialization.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong organizational leadership — someone who takes emotional ownership of outcomes, inspires engineering excellence, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Define and drive the long-term technical vision for the ETF engineering platform, ensuring alignment with Aladdin-wide architecture standards and BlackRock’s technology strategy.
Own domain architecture decisions across ESP and adjacent systems — including microservices decomposition, event-driven architectures (Kafka), cloud-native infrastructure, and API design.
Lead the resiliency strategy for ETF critical workflows (Creation/Redemption), including high availability, isolation, and graceful degradation across application and platform layers.
Establish and enforce engineering standards for code quality, observability, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release governance.

AI Strategy & Adoption

Define and execute the AI/GenAI adoption strategy for ETF Engineering — identifying high-value opportunities for AI-assisted development, intelligent automation, and AI-powered product features.
Drive adoption of AI engineering tools (e.g., code generation, automated testing, intelligent observability) to accelerate delivery velocity and engineering productivity.
Establish governance frameworks for responsible AI use — including model risk management, data governance, and compliance with BlackRock’s AI principles.
Partner with Aladdin AI/ML platform teams and vendor partners to evaluate, pilot, and scale AI capabilities across the ETF technology stack.

Delivery & Execution

Oversee delivery across multiple product engineering teams operating in an Agile/SAFe framework.
Drive release governance and software change management processes in partnership with Product Management and business stakeholders.
Manage cross-team dependencies with Aladdin platform teams and external integrations (DTCC/Fund/SERV, custodians, liquidity providers).

Regulatory Compliance, Risk & Resilience

Ensure all engineering practices and platform capabilities comply with global regulations, internal risk policies, and BlackRock’s technology risk framework.
Embed resilience, business continuity, and disaster recovery into system design — owning RCSA (Risk & Control Self-Assessment) obligations and audit readiness.
Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Cybersecurity teams to deliver “controls by design” — ensuring regulatory requirements are embedded in architecture, not bolted on.
Own production stability, support escalation, and incident management for ETF applications globally — driving continuous improvement in MTTR and operational efficiency.

Talent, Culture & Inclusion

Lead, develop, and inspire a globally distributed engineering organization across multiple time zones and cultures.
Own the engineering talent strategy: hiring, promotion calibration, organizational design, spans of control, and workforce planning.
Develop the next generation of engineering leaders at the VP and Director level — creating accountability, stretch opportunities, and clear career paths.
Champion a culture of engineering excellence, continuous learning, and innovation — where engineers take emotional ownership of their craft and are empowered to challenge the status quo.
Foster an inclusive, equitable environment where diverse perspectives are actively sought, valued, and leveraged to build better products and stronger teams. Model BlackRock’s commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of team leadership.

Stakeholder Partnership

Partner closely with Product Management to align engineering investment with business priorities and commercial strategy.
Collaborate with iShares business leadership, Capital Markets, Portfolio Management and Operations to deliver technology that supports BlackRock’s ETF growth agenda.
Represent ETF Engineering in Aladdin-wide forums, leadership reviews, and cross-product initiatives.

Qualifications

Required:

15+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with 5+ years in senior leadership roles managing large, globally distributed engineering teams.
Deep expertise in building and operating high-availability, mission-critical financial systems at scale.
Strong technical foundation in Java, microservices architecture, cloud-native infrastructure (Azure/AWS), event-driven systems (Kafka), distributed databases, and modern CI/CD practices.
Demonstrated ability to drive organizational design, talent development, and engineering culture in a fast-paced, regulated environment.
Proven track record of delivering resiliency, operational excellence, and engineering efficiency at enterprise scale.
Strong communication and influencing skills with the ability to partner effectively at the executive level and across business and technology functions.
BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

Preferred

Experience with ETF primary markets, capital markets technology, or investment management platforms.
Experience leading AI/GenAI adoption in engineering organizations — including tool evaluation, governance, and scaled implementation.
Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks in financial services (e.g., SOX, SEC, FCA).
Experience with Aladdin or comparable enterprise investment management platforms.

For San Francisco, CA and New York, NY Only the salary range for this position is USD$215,000.00 - USD$275,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
ABOUT CHARTMETRIC

Chartmetric is one of the music industry’s leading data analytics platforms, trusted by more than 8,000 customers, including major labels, management firms, and music professionals around the world.

Over the past decade, we’ve built a global data platform spanning streaming, social media, radio, playlists, charts, and audiences. Today, we have more than $11M in annual recurring revenue, a profitable business, and a lean, globally distributed team across the U.S. and Korea.

We’re now entering a new chapter. Alongside our core analytics platform, we’re building AI-native products like Chartmetric Flow that help people ask questions, explore data, and find insights in new ways.

We’re established enough to have meaningful scale and real customers, and small enough that your work can directly shape the company.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Head of Engineering to lead and develop the people building Chartmetric—and help them solve the problems that matter.

Working closely with our founder and CEO, Sung Cho (https://www.linkedin.com/in/sungmcho/), and our product and engineering leads, you’ll shape how we hire, organize, and run our engineering team. You’ll be accountable for the team’s performance, the quality of its work, and its ability to deliver.

People leadership is a central part of the role, alongside practical involvement in engineering. When a project stalls, a production issue escalates, or a technical decision needs clarity, you’ll get involved: ask questions, investigate causes, bring the right people together, and help drive a solution.

You won’t need to be the deepest expert in every part of our stack. You will need the judgment and curiosity to understand what’s happening, challenge assumptions, and recognize when a problem needs your direct attention.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Lead and develop engineers. Provide useful feedback, coach people through challenges, build career paths, and address performance issues directly and fairly.
Own engineering execution. Turn business priorities into realistic plans with product and engineering leads. Make ownership clear, manage dependencies, and take action when delivery slips.
Help solve engineering problems. Troubleshoot recurring issues, work through difficult tradeoffs, and help teams move forward when the answer is unclear. Stay involved until the problem is resolved.
Raise quality and reliability. Work with engineers to reduce recurring incidents, improve development and release practices, and balance new features with maintenance and technical debt.
Build the team thoughtfully. Own hiring priorities, strengthen interviewing and onboarding, and develop engineers who can take on broader responsibility.
Improve how we work. Make collaboration across teams and time zones more effective. Introduce enough structure to improve focus and accountability while keeping decisions and delivery moving.
Make AI useful in practice. Help the team adopt AI tools that improve development, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation, and evaluate whether they actually improve results.
Connect engineering to the business. Communicate progress, risks, and resource needs clearly, and help leadership understand the implications of engineering decisions.

WHO YOU ARE

You’ve successfully managed software engineers and can point to improvements in both individual performance and team results. You’ve hired people, developed talent, handled difficult conversations, and helped teams deliver through challenging periods.

You have a solid grounding in software engineering and experience solving real technical problems. You can follow a system design discussion, investigate why something is going wrong, and help engineers evaluate their options. You’re comfortable getting into technical details when the situation calls for it.

You take ownership when things get difficult.
If a release keeps slipping or an issue keeps returning, you work to understand the cause and help fix it. You know when to delegate, when to coach, and when to step in yourself.

You have good product and business judgment. You understand that engineering decisions involve tradeoffs among customer value, speed, quality, cost, and long-term maintainability.
You communicate clearly and build trust across engineering, product, and leadership. Experience working with distributed teams is particularly valuable.

You’re comfortable in a lean company where leaders stay close to the work. Experience with data-intensive products, SaaS platforms, or AI-enabled development is a plus. Music-industry experience is not required.

WHY CHARTMETRIC

You’ll help shape the engineering organization behind a profitable global business, with direct access to the founder and a clear connection between your work and customer outcomes.
Our challenges span large-scale data collection, analytics, product development, and new AI experiences. You’ll have room to improve an established platform while helping the team build what comes next.

COMPENSATION

$190,000–$250,000 base salary, plus equity and benefits.
The actual offer will depend on experience, qualifications, and the scope of responsibility.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through this posting. We’d love to hear about an engineering team you’ve led, a difficult problem you helped solve, and what improved because of your involvement.

jobs.title: Director of Technology & Chief Architect
jobs.description:
The role

High 5 Games is hiring a Director of Technology who is first and foremost a hands-on chief architect. You will shape the technical vision and grow into owning the architecture of a cloud platform built on hundreds of Java microservices that process millions of real-time transactions every day.

You will join a mature, high-volume platform that is already running in production. You'll spend your first 90 days learning it deeply, embedded with the teams that built it, and take ownership of its architecture domain by domain: starting with the data and transaction layer, then service architecture and the cloud platform. By the end of your first year, you'll own the platform's architecture end to end and set its direction for the years ahead.

This is not a slide-deck architect role. You will design systems, review code and schemas, set engineering standards, and lead the engineering and technology teams that build and run the platform. You must be comfortable explaining technology strategy and trade-offs to executives, business partners, and regulators.

The platform you will own

Hundreds of microservices, primarily Java, running in the cloud.
Millions of real-time transactions per day, where latency, consistency, and auditability matter on every one.
Regulated, money-adjacent workloads for social and sweepstakes casino gaming: wallets, purchases, game outcomes, and promotions.
24x7 availability for players across web and mobile.

Responsibilities

Architecture and system design

Take ownership of the microservices platform's architecture, domain by domain, through the first year, and then own it end to end: service boundaries, APIs, data ownership, and inter-service communication.
Design for high-volume, low-latency, real-time transaction processing with strong consistency and idempotency guarantees.
Define patterns for distributed transactions (sagas, outbox, event sourcing where appropriate), retries, and failure recovery.
Lead architecture reviews and keep a living record of decisions (ADRs) across hundreds of services.
Identify and pay down architectural debt; plan the evolution of legacy services without disrupting live traffic.

Java and data platforms

Set Java engineering standards: frameworks, libraries, build tooling, coding practices, and JVM tuning.
Own the database strategy across relational, NoSQL, caching, and streaming platforms, including schema design, partitioning, replication, and capacity.
Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across the JVM, the network, and the data layer.

Cloud, reliability, and operations

Guide the cloud architecture: containers, Kubernetes, managed data services, networking, and infrastructure as code.
Set SLOs, observability standards (metrics, tracing, logging), and incident response practices.
Drive scalability, resilience, disaster recovery, and cloud cost efficiency.
Ensure security, data protection, and auditability meet gaming regulatory and payment requirements.

Leadership

Build, lead, and mentor the engineering and technology teams; raise the bar on hiring.
Translate business goals into a technology roadmap and project plans.
Manage technical vendors and third-party platforms.
Evaluate new technology and tools and bring in what moves the platform forward.
Communicate technology strategy and risk clearly to the CEO, executives, and partners.

Required Qualifications

12+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years as an architect of large distributed systems.
Expert-level Java (Java 17+), with deep knowledge of Spring Boot / Spring Cloud, concurrency, and JVM performance tuning and garbage collection.
Proven track record designing and operating a microservices estate of 100+ services in production.
Hands-on experience with systems handling millions of real-time transactions per day, with measurable latency and uptime targets.
Deep database expertise: relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle) including query tuning, indexing, sharding, and replication, plus NoSQL and caching (e.g., Cassandra, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis).
Event-driven architecture with Kafka or a comparable streaming platform.
Production experience on AWS or GCP, with Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar).
Strong grasp of distributed-systems fundamentals: consistency models, idempotency, partitioning, backpressure, and failure modes.
Experience with API design (REST, gRPC), API gateways, and service mesh concepts.
Observability and reliability practice: Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog or similar; SLOs and incident management.
Experience leading and growing engineering teams, and evaluating and interviewing technical candidates.
Clear communicator with executives, peers, and individual contributors.

Preferred Qualifications

Background in gaming, iGaming, sweepstakes/social casino, sports betting, fintech, or payments.
Experience with wallet, ledger, or payment systems where every transaction must reconcile.
Familiarity with gaming regulatory, PCI DSS, or SOC 2 compliance requirements.
Led a migration or re-platforming of a monolith or legacy services to microservices with no downtime.
Experience with reactive or non-blocking Java (WebFlux, Vert.x, Netty) for high-throughput services.
Cloud cost optimization (FinOps) at scale.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Compensation And Benefits

The base salary range for this role is [TBD- Negotiable] per year, based on experience and skills.

Benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage; 401(k) and any match; paid time off and holidays; other programs

About High 5 Games

High 5 Games is a leader in casino gaming entertainment, developing for land-based, online, mobile, and social markets. We have created hundreds of games played in 150 countries on six continents, and we are building the most entertaining social casino experience on web and mobile.

Our team includes mathematicians, software engineers, game designers, data scientists, and artists. It is a dynamic, multidisciplinary, high-learning environment. See us at high5games.com.

To apply

Apply through our careers page with your resume and a short description of relevant experience. Links to GitHub projects, architecture write-ups, or talks are welcome.

High 5 Games is an equal opportunity employer. As a US employer, we verify that all employees, regardless of citizenship or national origin, are eligible to work in the United States. Principals only; recruiters, please don't contact us.

jobs.title: Head of Architecture and Engineering Governance, MD - State Street Investment Management
jobs.description:
State Street Investment Management (“State Street IM”, formerly State Street Global Advisors) is seeking a Global Head of Architecture and Engineering Governance to lead the firm’s enterprise-wide architecture and engineering governance function.

Operating within the broader Business and Technology Architecture organization—which encompasses Business Architecture, Solution Architecture, Technology Platform Engineering, Technology Operations & Resilience, and Architecture & Engineering Governance—this role is accountable for establishing and enforcing the enterprise guardrails that ensure architectural integrity, platform reuse, engineering consistency, and regulatory compliance across the end-to-end technology lifecycle.

Reporting to the Global Head of Business and Technology Architecture, this role serves as the enterprise design and engineering governance authority, ensuring that business strategy, architecture intent, platform capabilities, and engineering execution remain tightly aligned. The role plays a critical part in enabling State Street IM’s transformation toward a Product, Platform, and Service (PPS) operating model, powered by platform-based architectures and AI-enabled SDLC governance.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture & Engineering Governance

Define and own the enterprise architecture and engineering governance framework, spanning business-aligned solution design, platform usage, SDLC controls, and delivery assurance.
Establish clear decision rights, governance forums, and escalation models across Business Architecture, Solution Architecture, Platform Engineering, and Technology Operations.
Act as the enterprise authority for architectural and engineering compliance, balancing delivery velocity with risk, resilience, and control expectations.

Platform-Based Architecture Governance

Govern the adoption and usage of platform-based and composable architectures, ensuring reuse, interoperability, and scalability across portfolios.
Define architecture principles, reference architectures, and guardrails that guide Solution Architecture and Platform Engineering teams.
Ensure platform designs meet enterprise requirements for security, resilience, operability, performance, and cost transparency.

AI‑Enabled SDLC & Engineering Governance

Lead governance for AI-enabled software delivery, including AI-assisted design, development, testing, deployment, and operational tooling.
Define enterprise standards and controls for responsible AI use across the SDLC, including traceability, explainability, auditability, and risk management.
Partner with Engineering, QA, Security, and Risk teams to embed AI-enabled controls into CI/CD pipelines and delivery workflows.

Alignment Across Architecture & Technology Functions

Partner with Business Architecture to ensure business capabilities, outcomes, and value streams are translated into executable architecture intent.
Govern Solution Architecture consistency and quality through design reviews, standards enforcement, and lifecycle checkpoints.
Align with Technology Platform Engineering to ensure platforms adhere to enterprise standards and support long-term reuse and scalability.
Coordinate with Technology Operations & Resilience to ensure operability, resilience, and recovery considerations are embedded early in design.

Control, Risk & Regulatory Readiness

Ensure architectural and engineering governance supports regulatory expectations, audit readiness, and technology risk management.
Oversee exception management, remediation tracking, and governance-driven risk reduction initiatives.
Serve as a key partner to Risk, Security, Compliance, and Audit teams on architecture- and engineering-related matters.

Metrics, Transparency & Executive Reporting

Define and monitor governance-related KPIs and KRIs, including architectural compliance, platform adoption, technical debt, SDLC maturity, and delivery risk.
Provide executive-ready reporting and insights on architecture health, governance effectiveness, and systemic risks.
Drive continuous improvement of governance processes using data, automation, and tooling.

Required Qualifications

15+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, engineering leadership, or large-scale technology governance within regulated environments.
Proven track record leading architecture and engineering governance across complex, global organizations.
Deep expertise in platform-based architecture and enterprise-wide technology standardization.
Strong understanding of modern SDLC models, engineering practices, and governance controls in cloud and distributed environments.
Demonstrated experience embedding risk, security, and resilience considerations into architecture and engineering decision-making.
Experience operating within matrixed, multi‑function architecture organizations, with clear articulation of roles and decision boundaries.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder influence skills.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MSc, or equivalent) strongly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience governing AI‑enabled engineering and SDLC practices in regulated environments.
Strong background in enterprise and solution architecture frameworks and design governance models.
Experience with cloud-native, microservices-based, and distributed system architectures.
Familiarity with AWS and/or Azure governance and architecture standards.
Prior experience partnering closely with Quality Engineering, Technology Risk, Security Architecture, and Resilience functions.
Demonstrated success supporting large-scale platform and operating model transformations.

Salary Range

$170,000 - $282,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home .

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Description

Lead the technical vision and strategy for one of AWS's most critical storage services, managing multiple engineering teams building the world's most scalable, elastic, and fully managed cloud file storage. Your decisions will directly impact millions of active file systems, exabytes of stored data, and customers ranging from startups to the world's largest enterprises.

Key job responsibilities

**Build and develop engineering leadership**: Hire, mentor, and advance engineering leaders and senior engineers, creating an inclusive environment where technical talent can grow and contribute meaningfully to strategic initiatives.
**Define strategic technical vision**: Own a strategically important area of EFS architecture—such as the data plane, metadata service, or replication systems—and establish a 3–5 year technical roadmap that addresses the needs of large, critical customer bases.
**Drive architectural excellence**: Contribute to distributed systems design discussions, identify systemic risks and opportunities across the storage stack, and champion solutions that improve security, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
**Influence across organizational boundaries**: Partner with teams across S3, EBS, FSx, and the broader AWS ecosystem to reach consensus on technical direction, influence peer roadmaps, and deliver cohesive solutions that advance cloud storage capabilities.
**Establish operational excellence**: Create mechanisms to inspect service quality, customer experience, and operational health, while fostering a culture of innovation that encourages simplification and continuous improvement.

A day in the life

You'll spend your time balancing strategic leadership with hands-on technical engagement. Your day might include architecting solutions for distributed file system challenges, mentoring engineering leaders on complex technical decisions, and collaborating with peer teams across AWS Storage to advance cloud infrastructure capabilities. You'll participate in design reviews for critical components like metadata management and storage tiering, then shift to performance calibration conversations with your team leads. You'll also dedicate time to understanding customer needs and translating them into roadmap priorities, ensuring your teams are building solutions that matter at scale.

About The Team

We are a team of engineers and technical leaders committed to building foundational cloud storage infrastructure that powers some of the world's most demanding workloads. Our vision is to make elastic file storage seamlessly scalable, reliable, and accessible to organizations of all sizes. You'll work alongside Principal Engineers, Product Managers, and peer teams across AWS Storage, collaborating to advance the state of cloud infrastructure. We serve customers ranging from startups experimenting with containerized workloads to enterprises managing petabytes of data, and your leadership will help shape how we evolve to meet their changing needs. About Arevon

Arevon is a U.S. energy leader committed to powering America with affordable, reliable, and secure homegrown energy. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, and with a regional office in New York City, the company’s experienced and dedicated team develops, finances, builds, owns, and operates renewable energy projects nationwide. With a strong track record in utility-scale solar and energy storage, Arevon is a trusted partner to utilities and businesses seeking cost-effective, sustainable energy solutions. By prioritizing American manufacturing and domestic energy production, the company invests in U.S. jobs, strengthens local economies, and advances the country’s energy independence.

The Position

Arevon is recruiting for the position of Senior Manager, HV Engineering, an outstanding opportunity for individuals seeking an exciting, high-growth work environment in one of the most important industries for the 21st century.
Key Responsibilities

The Senior Manager, HV Engineering will be responsible for providing high voltage (HV) technical oversight for PV and BESS projects during development and construction.  The responsibilities include supporting the full HV project lifecycle including: development of scope of work documents, drafting & reviewing commissioning requirements, responding to technical RFI, and communicating with counterparties and internal stakeholders. The role requires detailed analysis and interpretation of HV related civil, structural, and electrical Prudent Industry Practices, codes, and standards. The role will be part of the Engineering team and will report directly to the Director, Project Engineering. The responsibilities of a Senior Manager, HV Engineering include, but are not limited to: 
Lead engineer driving HV designs from development to Final Completion for utility scale PV and/or BESS projects.
HV SME charged with developing HV engineering, procurement, and construction RFPs and scopes of work, as well as managing 3 rd party contractor (EOR and EPC) negotiations, including scope, cost, and schedule.
Providing HV subject matter expertise for substation, utility switchyard, SCADA, and generation tie-line (gen-tie) design packages, including responsibility for the review of all HV equipment specifications, data sheets, drawings, studies, and calculations. 
Review and manage civil, structural, and electrical technical deliverables.
Review and respond to HV technical RFI responses throughout the project lifecycle.
Manage the EOR and EPC during the design phase and throughout the course of project execution of large-scale PV and BESS projects as it pertains to HV. 
Perform due diligence on project documentation and communicate fatal flaws to management.  This will include the review of PPAs, Interconnection Agreements, existing conceptual and detailed design, drawings, specifications, data sheets, test reports, and siting of gen-tie lines for conformance to the project needs.
Participate in constructability reviews and analyze options to optimize cost and schedule.
Review of HV electrical design calculations for electrical loads, short circuit, dynamic stability, power factor, harmonics, coordination studies, and other studies as required.
Support the estimation team to accurately populate HV engineering budget estimates based on available project technical due diligence.
Ensure HV design and installation meet applicable codes and standards, such as NESC, NFPA, ASME, NEC, ANSI, IEEE.
Able and willing to travel to both active construction sites and sites in development.
Support project finance, estimating, and performance engineering to minimize risk and identify fatal flaws.  
In-house HV commissioning lead for substation, gen-tie, and switchyard as applicable, which will typically involve reviewing commissioning and testing plans, as well as analyzing the results of such tests. 
Acts as liaison with Arevon Project Management and senior management on matters relating to engineering progress, quality, scope and technical/permitting issues.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, required. 
8+ years of hands-on experience as an HV engineer working with solar, BESS, or another related industry required.
Excellent interpersonal skills, highly motivated and results oriented, process oriented with strong organizational and communication skills.
Knowledge of engineering and renewable energy systems; solar PV & BESS systems including SCADA and monitoring systems.
Knowledge of site power & design calculations, plan preparation; site collector system calculations & report writing.
Understanding of project design and optimization tradeoffs and familiarity with current market, equipment suppliers, contractors, typical technical specifications, and costs.
Experience and understanding of PV + BESS project HV design, optimization, suppliers, specifications and costs; including contracting approaches.
Knowledgeable in NEC, NESC, IEC, IBC, NFPA standards related to solar, BESS and substation design.
Demonstrated experience with high-voltage transmission and interconnection facilities (typically 69 kV through 500 kV), including substations, switchyards, collector systems, and generation tie-lines.
Working knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards and FERC regulatory requirements as they relate to generator interconnections, bulk electric system assets, grid reliability, and utility-scale renewable energy projects.
Experience supporting or reviewing utility interconnection studies, including short-circuit, protection and controls, stability, power quality, and voltage analyses.
Familiarity with transmission owners, balancing authorities, regional transmission organizations (RTOs), and independent system operators (ISOs), and their technical requirements for project development and energization.
Ability to interpret and apply utility, NERC, and FERC requirements during project design, commissioning, and operational readiness activities.

Proficient or able to learn Aconex, SiteTracker.

jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, IGA is a senior technical and client-facing leadership role focused on driving Identity Governance and Administration engagements from strategy through execution, with SailPoint and Saviynt as core platforms of expertise. This role requires the ability to lead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients – translating complex governance, compliance, and identity lifecycle requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures. While IGA is the primary focus, the ideal candidate also brings working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains, including Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Access Management (SSO/MFA), to design cohesive, end-to-end identity solutions. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, architect enterprise-grade IGA solutions, and lead cross-functional delivery teams, while also contributing to business development, proposal development, and practice growth.

Key Responsibilities

Lead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients, translating business, security, and compliance requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures.
Architect and oversee end-to-end implementation of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions using SailPoint and Saviynt as primary platforms.
Design and lead delivery of core IGA capabilities, including identity lifecycle management (Joiner/Mover/Leaver), access certification/attestation campaigns, role-based access control (RBAC) and role mining, Segregation of Duties (SoD) policy design, entitlement management, and access request/approval workflows.
Lead application onboarding strategy for IGA platforms, including source/target connector design, birthright and non-birthright provisioning, and integration with authoritative HR sources
Define and implement IGA governance frameworks, including policy design, audit and compliance reporting, and global configuration/data segmentation best practices.
Working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains – Privileged Access Management (PAM, e.g., CyberArk, Delinea) and Access Management (SSO/MFA via Entra ID, Okta, Ping) – to ensure IGA architectures integrate cleanly across the broader identity ecosystem.
Own end-to-end delivery for engagements, managing scope, timelines, technical quality, and client satisfaction.
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, running architecture workshops, discovery sessions, and executive-level readouts.
Develop maturity assessments, governance roadmaps, and target operating models tailored to client environments and industry (e.g., healthcare, higher education, financial services).
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and career development to IAM engineers, architects, and consultants on the delivery team.
Partner with sales and account teams on business development activities, including solution scoping, proposal/SOW development, and technical presentations for prospective clients.
Advise clients on regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR) as they relate to identity governance controls, certifications, and audits.
Monitor emerging IGA trends and best practices (including AI-driven governance) and champion their adoption across client engagements.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
10+ years of hands-on IAM experience with a strong concentration in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), including consulting or client-facing delivery, and at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or architecture role.
Deep, hands-on expertise architecting and implementing SailPoint and Saviynt, including certification campaigns, RBAC/SoD design, connector configuration, and workflow customization.
Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, entitlement governance, access certification processes, and provisioning/de-provisioning across enterprise applications.
Working knowledge of PAM concepts and platforms (e.g., CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust) and Access Management/SSO technologies (e.g., Entra ID, Okta, Ping) sufficient to architect integrated IAM solutions.
Proven ability to lead technical architecture discussions and design sessions directly with client stakeholders, including CISOs and IT leadership.
Solid understanding of identity protocols and standards, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and LDAP.
Experience managing project resources, timelines, and deliverables across multiple concurrent engagements.
Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing technical teams, with strong people leadership skills.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences.
Relevant certifications strongly preferred (e.g., CISSP, CISM, SailPoint Certified, Saviynt Certified Professional).

jobs.description:
Job Title:
Director of Engineering - Managed File Transfer
Location:
Remote (HQ in San Francisco)

Position Overview

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Director of Engineering to lead the Managed File Transfer engineering organization. This role is responsible for defining technical vision and delivery for secure, high availability file transfer products and services used by critical infrastructure and enterprise customers. The Director will drive architecture, SDLC best practices, cloud-native modernization, CI/CD, and secure engineering while scaling teams that build .NET/C# and AI-powered solutions for data movement and protection.

Key Responsibilities

Set technical strategy and roadmap for Managed File Transfer products, aligning engineering goals with business priorities and customer needs.
Lead, mentor, and grow multiple engineering teams including backend, cloud, SRE, QA, and security-focused engineers working on .NET/C# and cloud-native platforms.
Own architecture and design for high-availability, secure file transfer systems (SFTP, AS2, FTP/S, MQ, APIs), ensuring scalability for critical infrastructure workloads.
Drive full SDLC maturity: feature lifecycle, release planning, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and observability to achieve reliable, repeatable delivery.
Champion cloud-native modernization using containers, Kubernetes, serverless patterns, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/ARM) on public clouds (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Partner with Product, Security, Compliance, and Customer Success to define secure-by-design approaches for data security, encryption, key management, and regulatory compliance (SOC2, NIST, PCI, HIPAA as applicable).
Own incident response readiness and production reliability practices (SLOs/SLIs), postmortems, and continuous improvement for critical customer environments.
Introduce and scale AI-enabled capabilities (e.g., intelligent routing, anomaly detection, metadata extraction) while ensuring model governance and data privacy.
Manage hiring, budgeting, resource planning, and vendor/partner relationships to meet roadmap commitments and SLAs.
Promote engineering best practices: code reviews, architectural principles, performance engineering, and mentorship programs to raise team effectiveness.

Qualifications

10+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5 years in senior engineering leadership or director roles overseeing multiple teams.
Proven experience building and operating Managed File Transfer or secure data movement products, protocols, and integrations (SFTP, AS2, FTPS, MQ, APIs).

jobs.description:
Description

The Director of Datacenter Security Systems leads the global implementation of security controls within AWS datacenters. From creation through datacenter retirement, this role is accountable for delivering innovative security controls that meet the business needs for scale and speed. This role coordinates across design, construction, networking, and partner software teams to deliver physical and logical controls through software and process innovation, and is accountable for both building innovative solutions and operating them at fleet scale.

Infrastructure Security is looking for an experienced Director of Software Development to transform how we create and maintain datacenter security controls across Amazon. You will operate Tier-1 services foundational to AWS datacenter operations and define the approach for deploying security at the speed of modular builds while continuously raising the security bar across all of AWS.

This opportunity is multi-disciplinary, requiring depth of knowledge and experience in security solutions, software development, building design, product management, AWS services, and cost control. It requires a leader who can deliver security solutions within the context of business outcomes and drive iterative improvement in an environment where both the threat landscape and the pace of construction are changing rapidly.

You will draw from deep and broad technical expertise to guide software engineers, principal engineers, and development managers on system design, incremental delivery, and operational excellence. You will apply AI and machine learning to transform how your systems operate: from computer vision that performs real-time authorization decisions, to automated triage and anomaly detection, to intelligent provisioning that eliminates manual effort. This role has substantial visibility with senior executives and is built for a leader who thrives on pace, ambiguity, and building high-performing teams from the ground up.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end design, delivery, and operation of datacenter security systems globally, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter detection, and the software platforms that manage them
Transform cameras into active assurance mechanisms through computer vision that performs real-time physical authorization linked to work order systems, reducing reliance on manual observation for access verification
Deliver security infrastructure that ships at modular build speed: persistent hardware from construction through operations, standardized security kits, and zero-touch provisioning that eliminates per-site engineering effort
Build and operate a Tier-1 service owning the complete lifecycle of every networked security IoT device globally: onboarding, firmware management, credential rotation, health monitoring, and performance telemetry
Drive security economics that deliver equivalent or better outcomes at lower cost per site as the fleet scales
Define and deliver AI-driven capabilities including computer vision for real-time authorization, automated triage and anomaly detection, generative AI for development acceleration, and intelligent provisioning that eliminates manual effort
Lead and scale a high-performing engineering organization spanning software development, systems engineering, hardware engineering, and program management

A day in the life

This role spends most days working hand in hand with datacenter operations and datacenter engineering teams. You will advocate for logical security controls across AWS service teams to meet the demands of a modular datacenter build plan, ensuring that every layer of the defense-in-depth continuum is instrumented, measured, and delivering against the security bar at the speed the business requires.

About The Team

The Infrastructure Security Team is accountable for ensuring that the foundation of AWS operates and scales securely. This team is responsible for the security of the hardware supply chain, AWS datacenters, and the AWS network. We build operational security solutions that are critical to the operations of AWS infrastructure, including identity management, security telemetry and threat analysis, hardware component validation, and ensuring third-party suppliers meet the AWS security bar.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field) or equivalent work experience
10+ years developing mission-critical system software, with 5+ years driving long-term engineering and product decisions at senior leadership level
Track record of delivering innovative cloud-based applications and services at scale
Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain an inclusive, high-performing organization of 100+ engineers
Experience scaling diverse, highly dynamic, and fast-growing technical and product teams across multiple geographies

Preferred Qualifications

15+ years managing and building software with very high availability and operational excellence requirements
Deep understanding of information security, privacy frameworks, and compliance requirements
Ability to effectively coordinate between technical teams and business stakeholders
Strong ability to build alignment to your teams' vision across diverse business leaders
Ability to drive enterprise-scale changes to existing systems
Effective written and oral communication with multiple levels of leadership involving both business and technical sides of the organization

This position demands a deep understanding of both traditional application development and modern DevOps practices to ensure seamless integration, continuous delivery, and operational excellence. jobs.description:

Amazon Leo (previously known as Project Kuiper) is an ecosystem with a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) within Amazon Leo is developing secure, high-performance satellite communications technologies that support U.S. National and International security and defense.

This position requires that the candidate selected

be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

10037

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for an exceptional engineering leader to join us as a Senior Manager, leading the software architecture, design, implementation and integration of ALG developed device endpoints. These devices enable Government customer required RF, Optical and Network layer connectivity with Amazon Leo system, and integrate with ground solutions, network solutions, ALG business and operational support systems.

This role is responsible for designing, building out, and maintaining foundational software that extends Amazon Leo capabilities to US Government customers such as NASA, DoD, other National Security customers, and International Government customers. You will own developing and delivering software for mission critical space safety and sustainability applications which will automatically coordinate with external systems and organizations rapidly, reliably, and at scale.

You’ll work in a fast-paced, high-impact environment, tackling complex challenges in secure satellite communications. You’ll collaborate closely with hardware, security, systems, and product teams to develop scalable, real-time solutions tailored for Government customers.

You will own the roadmap and mission for Software and work with your customers to refine requirements, understand constraints, hire & grow your team and iteratively deliver value to our customers.

Key Job Responsibilities

Lead multiple teams (manager of managers) of firmware, embedded systems and services software engineers.
Manage and develop employees, including hiring, retention, performance management, mentoring and capability/skill development.
Work with peer teams and customers to design suitable software systems and interfaces to fulfill the government customer use cases.
Collaborate with peer teams to integrate various system elements, both hardware and software.

This role is based in our Northridge, CA site with U.S. relocation benefits available. Due to the sensitive nature of the ALG projects, onsite work is required five days a week.

About The Team

ALG Software organization architects, designs, develops, delivers, and operates software for ALG products and services that span across Space and Ground segments of the Amazon Leo system. The team is responsible for embedded software running on ALG developed RF, Optical, and Networking device endpoints connected to the Amazon Leo system, and services software running on AWS cloud.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of engineering experience
10+ years of software development experience
5+ years of engineering team management experience
Experience partnering with product or program management teams
Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment
10+ years of embedded software development experience with proven expertise in mission-critical systems development, specifically satellite or ground based communication/networking systems

Preferred Qualifications

Experience partnering with product and program management teams
Experience in Networking/Wireless Communication Systems or RF engineering
Experience leading teams in aerospace or other safety critical industry
Experience establishing metrics for measurement of engineering and operational excellence

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product & Technology Marketing— Optical & Data Center Systems
jobs.description:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell's Global Marketing organization mission is to accelerate Marvell’s growth by delivering impactful outcomes and services that elevate our brand, captivate our target audiences, and exceed stakeholder expectations. The organization encompasses communications, digital, events, social, analyst relations, marketing research, and portfolio marketing. We collaborate closely with Marvell's business units, investor relations, finance, HR, and executive staff to ensure our messaging and positioning resonate effectively with diverse global audiences.

What You Can Expect

The Sr. Director, Product & Technology Marketing for the Data Center Networking Business Group will own the outbound marketing strategy for Marvell's photonic fabric, co-packaged optics (CPO), optical connectivity, data center switching, and data center interconnect (DCI) portfolio. This is a high-stakes, system-level marketing role — the target audience is not component buyers, but platform decision-makers: system architects at hyperscalers and data center operators who are making infrastructure-level choices about how to scale AI clusters beyond the rack. The marketing challenge is translating silicon-level photonic innovation into a compelling end-to-end narrative about the future of AI-scale connectivity — from millimeters between chips on a co-packaged optics module, to photonic fabric and high-radix switching connecting XPU to XPU within the cluster, to coherent DCI solutions spanning kilometers between data centers.

Product Marketing & Outbound Strategy

Own the full outbound marketing strategy for Marvell's Optical & Data Center Systems portfolio — amplifying Marvell's market-leading connectivity position across photonic fabric, CPO, data center switching, and coherent DCI — through differentiated positioning, compelling messaging, and targeted channel activation that drives awareness and preference with hyperscaler and data center operator audiences.
Define and maintain differentiated value propositions and messaging hierarchies for each portfolio segment; ensure consistent, compelling communication of Marvell's competitive advantages to external audiences.
Lead product launch planning and execution, driving cross-functional readiness across sales, PR, analyst relations, digital, and events to maximize market impact at launch.
Develop competitive response playbooks and sales enablement content — including pitch decks, solution briefs, battle cards, and objection-handling guides — that equip customer-facing teams to win.
Partner with product management and engineering teams to deeply understand technology roadmaps; translate product capabilities into external marketing strategies, not internal product plans.

Technology Marketing & Thought Leadership

The Director of Software Engineering is responsible for defining and communicating the long-term vision and roadmap for software development and DevOps practices while driving organizational transformation toward Agile, CI/CD, and DevOps maturity. This role ensures alignment of technology initiatives with business objectives, champions innovation through technologies such as Infrastructure as Code and AI/ML, and oversees the end-to-end software development lifecycle to guarantee quality, scalability, and security. The Director establishes and enforces best practices for coding standards, secure development (DevSecOps), and compliance frameworks, while implementing and optimizing CI/CD pipelines and containerization across robust cloud environments. At Gravitics, we're not just exploring space—we're building it. We're creating the infrastructure for a thriving space economy, enabling humanity to flourish beyond Earth. This is a hands-on leadership role at a company where directors are still close to the hardware: you'll set technical direction, unblock your teams, and represent engineering to the executive team, customers, and government partners.

You'll report to the Chief Operating Officer and be a key member of the engineering leadership team as Gravitics scales from prototype to flight-qualified, repeatable hardware.

Responsibilities:

Own engineering execution for one or more major programs cost, schedule, technical performance, and quality from concept through delivery and flight
Build, lead, and grow multidisciplinary teams spanning mechanical/structures, propulsion, avionics, and flight software
Set technical strategy and make build-vs-buy, make-vs-partner, and architecture trade-off calls in a resource-constrained startup environment
Establish and mature engineering processes (design reviews, requirements management, configuration control, verification & validation) appropriate for human-rated and government/defense hardware
Partner closely with Manufacturing, Test, Quality, and Program Management to move designs from CAD to flight article on aggressive timelines
Represent engineering in customer and government program reviews
Recruit, mentor, and retain top engineering talent; build the technical culture and hiring bar as the team scales
Manage program risk, drive root-cause resolution on technical issues, and communicate status and trade-offs clearly to executive leadership

About You

Required Attributes

10+ years in aerospace/spacecraft engineering, with 4+ years in a people-leadership role (engineering manager, director, or equivalent)

Deep technical fluency across at least one core discipline (structures, mechanisms, propulsion, avionics, or GN&C/flight software) and working knowledge across the rest

jobs.description:
Description

Prime Video operates one of the largest and most complex streaming infrastructures in the world, serving hundreds of millions of customers across live sports, movies, and TV in more than 240 countries and territories. Ensuring that this infrastructure scales predictably, runs efficiently, and protects customer privacy is foundational to the business. We are hiring a Senior Software Development Manager to own three of the most consequential infrastructure disciplines within Prime Video.

This leader will report directly to the Director of READI and be accountable for how Prime Video plans for scale, drives cost and resource efficiency across core compute and AI infrastructure, and upholds customer privacy as a first-class engineering discipline. This is a broad role that spans predictive capacity planning, deep infrastructure optimization, and privacy engineering — requiring a leader who is equally comfortable in a data-driven forecasting review, an architecture deep-dive on compute and GPU efficiency, and a privacy risk assessment with legal and security partners.

The successful candidate is a seasoned engineering leader who builds and develops high-performing teams, sets multi-year technical strategy, and delivers measurable results in ambiguous, high-scale environments. They will lead through other managers and senior engineers, influence peer organizations and partner teams across Prime Video and AWS, and represent Prime Video’s infrastructure posture to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities

PV Scale Forecasting & Capacity Assurance

Own the end-to-end discipline of forecasting demand and assuring capacity across Prime Video’s infrastructure footprint, ensuring the service scales reliably for both predictable growth and peak events (e.g., major live sports, tentpole launches, and global releases).

Own multi-year and event-based capacity models that translate business growth, content strategy, and traffic patterns into infrastructure demand across compute, storage, network, and CDN.

Lead capacity assurance for high-stakes live events, establishing headroom targets, load-testing regimes, and go/no-go readiness reviews with partner teams.

Build a forecasting practice grounded in data science and telemetry — improving forecast accuracy, quantifying confidence intervals, and reducing both over-provisioning waste and under-provisioning risk.

Partner on demand-planning and capacity-management processes with AWS, finance, and PV service teams so that capacity is secured ahead of need at the right cost.

Define the mechanisms (dashboards, reviews, and escalation paths) that give leadership confidence that Prime Video will scale for every moment that matters.

PV Infrastructure Efficiency (Core Compute & AI Infrastructure)

Drive infrastructure efficiency as a durable, measurable engineering discipline across Prime Video’s core compute fleet and its rapidly growing AI/ML infrastructure, materially improving unit economics while protecting reliability and performance.

Set the efficiency strategy and roadmap for core compute (CPU fleets, containerized services, memory/DRAM footprint) and AI infrastructure (GPU/accelerator fleets, training and inference platforms).

Drive down infrastructure cost-to-serve and improve utilization through right-sizing, fleet consolidation, hardware refresh strategy, and adoption of more efficient compute and runtimes.

Optimize the efficiency of AI/ML workloads — GPU utilization, training throughput, inference cost per request — partnering with science and platform teams to eliminate waste in one of PV’s fastest-growing spend areas.

Establish efficiency goals with clear metrics (utilization, cost per stream/request, DRAM and energy footprint) and instrument the fleet so gains are visible, attributable, and durable.

Lead zero-based capacity and efficiency reviews, and represent PV in senior compute-allocation and cost-optimization forums.

PV Privacy

Own privacy as a first-class engineering discipline for Prime Video infrastructure, ensuring that customer data is handled in accordance with Amazon’s privacy commitments and global regulatory obligations by design and by default.

Own the privacy engineering roadmap for PV infrastructure — data handling, minimization, retention, access controls, and auditability across the services and fleets in scope.

Embed privacy-by-design into capacity, compute, and AI infrastructure decisions, ensuring new systems and AI/ML workloads meet privacy requirements before launch.

Partner closely with Legal, Security, and central Privacy teams to translate regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR and regional privacy laws) into concrete engineering controls and mechanisms.

Build the mechanisms that detect, prevent, and remediate privacy risks — tooling, reviews, and metrics that make privacy posture measurable and continuously improving.

Champion a culture of privacy ownership across the team, raising the bar on how PV builds and operates infrastructure that customers trust.

About The Team

READI (Reliability, Efficiency, Availability, Defense & Integrity) is the Prime Video organization chartered to keep one of the world’s largest streaming services fast, efficient, resilient, and trustworthy. We sit at the intersection of infrastructure, operations, and customer trust — the team that ensures Prime Video scales for every tentpole launch and live event, spends every infrastructure dollar wisely, and protects customer data by design.

This role anchors three of READI’s most strategic charters — scale forecasting and capacity assurance, infrastructure efficiency across core compute and AI infrastructure, and privacy engineering. You will lead a team of managers and senior engineers, and partner daily with Prime Video service teams, AWS, Finance, Legal, Security, and central Privacy. The work is high-visibility and high-impact: our decisions show up in customer experience during the biggest moments of the year, in Prime Video’s cost structure, and in the trust customers place in how we handle their data.

We are a team that thinks long-term, dives deep on data, and holds a high bar. We invest in our people, promote from within, and give leaders room to set strategy and own outcomes end to end. If you are energized by hard technical problems at massive scale and by building teams that raise the bar, you will fit right in.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of engineering team management experience
Experience partnering with product or program management teams
12+ years of engineering experience
12+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred Qualifications

Experience partnering with product and program management teams
Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications
